annotation_provenance: Single assistant visual point selection on grid views before any inference on these five sources; not model-generated, not expert-adjudicated. Approximate anatomical joint centres; hidden joints omitted. Labels frozen 2026-09-27 after source-only acquisition run 36340164491 and before model comparison. Anatomical left/right; rear view does not swap labels.
changes: Changed for evaluation: selected source video frames, resized full images without cropping, metadata stripped, RGB PNG derivatives. Source-specific raw-raster EXIF correction for dip_cropped is documented. Approximate visible-joint reference labels added. No endorsement.
scope: Five source files; four photographs and 45 ordered frames of a separate pull-up video. Approximate single-reviewer 2D diagnostic references, unassigned subjects, no held-out, 3D, form, count or phone-performance qualification.
